content:
As always, for the next few days users posting on X with the #AppleEvent hashtag will see a special Apple logo hashmoji appear in their posts. See below for details.

#AppleEvent hashmoji is now live on X

As has been the case for years, whenever Apple announces a new event, the company rolls out an accompanying hashmoji on X.

Following this morning's event invitation, which featured an apple-shaped halo around a sun with the tagline "Surprise and shine," the company's new hashmoji has now gone live on X.

That means users posting on the platform with #AppleEvent will see a special Apple logo—based on the invitation artwork—appear alongside the hashtag.

Apple's "Surprise and shine" event is scheduled for September 9 at 10 a.m. Pacific Time, where the company is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with its first foldable iPhone. New Apple Watch and AirPods models are also rumored.

Apple's hashmoji went live just hours after Greg Jozwiak, Apple's senior vice president of marketing, teased it in a post on X. Tim Cook subsequently reposted Jozwiak's post with a comment of his own.

Interestingly, some have interpreted Cook's countdown as an Easter egg hinting at his own countdown: he is just days away from stepping down as Apple CEO on September 1 to become executive chairman of the company.

9to5Mac will be on the ground at Apple Park on September 9—stay tuned for our coverage before, during, and after the event.

What are you looking forward to from this event? Let us know in the comments.
